id: title:danielcarletti:reject cdc sync type on sources without a cdc adapter

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse CDC ingestion safety and test coverage
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 adds a runtime check against warehouse CDC support, preventing configuration errors for unsupported warehouse types. P1.F2.H2 updates warehouse schema API tests to cover rejection of unsupported replication types. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include implementation of helper functions, so the exact dependency and broader architectural impact cannot be verified; tier relies on the visible check and test updates.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the helper function `is_cdc_enabled_for_team` nor the definition of `source_type_supports_cdc`. The P1.F2.H2 hunk relies on mocking this helper, while P1.F1.H1 uses a different helper. Without seeing the implementation and dependency resolution, it is impossible to distinguish whether this is a new capability, a bug fix, or a refact

observations.behavior: Adds a check before CDC processing: if the source type does not support CDC, raise ValidationError.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents accepting CDC replication for warehouse sources that lack a CDC adapter, avoiding configuration errors.

observations.behavior: Replaces a specific test for non-Postgres xmin rejection with a parameterized test covering both xmin and cdc, and checks the expected error message.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates warehouse schema API tests to cover rejection of unsupported replication types, including CDC, regardless of database engine.
